paragraph:
Velmoria, the seventy-year audit
A (critical), (empirical) review asks whether the republic's success is real or merely (apocryphal)
LET THIS chapter be (critical) rather than ceremonial. Seventy years after the fall of the marshal, Velmoria has commissioned not a celebration but an audit—a sober, (empirical) review of whether the republic's long success is solid fact or partly (apocryphal) legend. The commissioners were chosen to be (sceptical), (methodical), and (univocal) in their findings, and instructed to (overlook) nothing.
The exercise was deliberately unromantic. A jubilee can lapse into (whimsical), (nonsensical) self-praise; an audit cannot. So the reviewers set aside the (metaphysical) and the (hypothetical) and stuck to the (empirical): budgets, court records, election data, the (statistical) bedrock beneath the (ethereal) talk of "freedom." They would not (shirk) the hard numbers, nor (brook) the comfortable (tautological) reasoning—"the republic endures because it is enduring"—that passes for analysis in lazier hands.
Their first finding was reassuring but (stark). The institutions are sound; the prosperity is real, not (apocryphal). The economy is (economical) and well-run, neither swollen to (astronomical) excess nor shrunk to a (hulk) of its former self. Corruption, where it persists, is (piecemeal) and (vestigial) rather than systemic. The courts remain (critical) and independent; the press, sharp and (polemical) when it must be, (genial) when it can. The (hallmark) of the system, the auditors wrote, is its refusal to (overlook) its own faults.
But the review was not all praise, and here it earned its keep. The commissioners flagged a (cyclical) complacency—a tendency, every generation or so, to (shirk) the unglamorous maintenance of liberty. They warned of a (parochial) drift in the provinces, a (clannish) localism that could (shrink) the national spirit. They noted, too, a (lackadaisical) civic education in places, where the marshal's era was taught as (apocryphal) myth rather than (empirical) history—a (critical) failing, since a people who treat tyranny as a fairy tale are the likeliest to (flunk) its real test.
It is worth recalling, as the audit did, exactly what the marshal was. He was a (mountebank) in a (regal) costume, a (diabolical) (cabal) of one, whose every (pontifical) decree was (nonsensical) beneath its (swank). His rule rested on a (cult)—an (inimical), (pathological) thing—dressed in (canonical), (ecumenical) language to seem holy. He would (spank) dissent like a (parochial) schoolmaster, (shirk) all accountability, and (repeal) any law that pricked his vanity. He built an (obelisk) to himself in every square, each one stamped with an (asterisk) of false achievement.
The republic that replaced him is, by contrast, almost defiantly ordinary. Its leaders wear no (medal)s of self-glory; they (pedal) modestly to work past the market (kiosk)s. Power has been made (mechanical) and (methodical), bound by (canonical) rules rather than (whimsical) will. No (marshal) may again make the state his (filial) inheritance or his (connubial) dowry. The (conjugal) and the official are kept (vertical)ly separate; no leader may (repeal) the constitution to crown his own (lineal) heir.
The audit's recommendations were (piecemeal) and practical. Refurbish civic education, lest the young grow (sceptical) of the wrong things. Guard against the (centrifugal) forces that pull a (commonwealth) apart. Keep the courts (critical), the press free, the elections clean. Resist the (mountebank) who (winks) at the rule of law and the (swank) populist who (barks) easy answers. Above all, treat liberty as an (empirical), maintainable fact, not an (ethereal) or (sidereal) abstraction floating beyond reach.
Beyond the ledgers, the country went about its (genial) business. A craftsman carved (fretwork) for a restored hall; a farmer sorted (cereal) and (oatmeal) at the (kiosk); a (chipmunk) and a bold (skunk) raided the (arboreal) edge of an orchard while children laughed. A (whimsical) poet read a (madrigal) in the square; an old (sandal)-maker, (prodigal) with his time, taught the trade to a (filial) apprentice. The republic's life was neither (regal) nor (funereal) but plainly, (congenial)ly human.
There were, inevitably, dissenters from the audit. A (polemical) faction called it (parochial) nitpicking; a (heretical) populist dismissed it as the work of a (cabal) of elites, all (verbal) cleverness and no (spunk). He would gladly (repeal) its findings, (shirk) its warnings, and (debark) the republic onto the old, (diabolical) shore of strongman rule. But the public, (sceptical) of his (mountebank)'s (swank), declined to (flunk) the test the auditors set. They read the report, weighed its (critical) eye, and found it (cordial) to their own (empirical) sense of things.
So Velmoria, seventy years free, submits even its triumphs to (critical) scrutiny. It refuses the (apocryphal) comfort of a perfect record and the (funereal) gloom of false decline alike. The marshal sought to be a (regal), (incorporeal) ideal beyond all audit; his country has chosen the opposite—to count its faults honestly, to (heal) what it can in (piecemeal) good faith, and to treat its own freedom not as an (empyreal) gift but as an (empirical), (methodical), endlessly renewable habit. A republic, the auditors concluded, is never finished and never (univocal); it survives precisely because it is willing, every seventy years or seven, to (overlook) nothing and (shirk) no hard question about itself.
translation:
韦尔莫利亚，七十年大审计

*一场（审慎挑剔/critical)、（基于实证的/empirical）评估追问：这个共和国的成功是真实的，还是仅仅（杜撰存疑/apocryphal)*

让这一章是（审慎挑剔的/critical)，而非礼节性的。元帅倒台七十年后，韦尔莫利亚委托进行的不是一场庆典，而是一次审计——一场冷静、（基于实证的/empirical）评估，以查明这个共和国漫长的成功究竟是坚实的事实、还是部分（杜撰存疑的/apocryphal）传说。委员们被选出来时，须是（怀疑审慎/sceptical)、（条理缜密/methodical)、且在其结论上（单义明确的/univocal)，并被指示对任何事都不可（疏忽放过/overlook)。

这桩活动刻意地不带浪漫色彩。一场金禧可能堕入（异想天开/whimsical)、（荒唐无稽的/nonsensical）自我吹捧；一次审计则不能。于是评估者们把（形而上的/metaphysical）和（假设性的/hypothetical）东西搁在一边，紧扣（实证的/empirical）东西：预算、法庭记录、选举数据、那些"自由"（缥缈空灵的/ethereal）空谈之下的（统计学/statistical）基岩。他们不会（回避推诿/shirk）那些硬邦邦的数字，也不会（容忍/brook）那种在更懒散之人手里冒充分析的、令人安适的（同义反复的/tautological）推理——"这个共和国之所以长存，是因为它在长存"。

他们的第一项发现令人安心、却也（赤裸严峻/stark)。种种制度稳健；繁荣是真实的，而非（杜撰存疑的/apocryphal)。这个经济（节俭精打细算/economical）且管理有方，既没膨胀到（天文数字般/astronomical）的过度，也没缩水成它昔日的一具（空壳/hulk)。腐败，在其残存之处，是（零零碎碎/piecemeal)、（残余遗痕般的/vestigial)，而非系统性的。法庭依然（具批判性/critical）而独立；新闻界，在必须如此时尖锐而（好辩论战的/polemical)，在可以如此时（和蔼亲切/genial)。审计员们写道，这套系统的（标志特征/hallmark)，就在于它拒绝（疏忽放过/overlook）自身的缺陷。

但这场评估并非全是赞誉，而正是在这里它对得起自己的价值。委员们标出了一种（周期性的/cyclical）自满——一种大约每隔一代人便要（回避推诿/shirk）自由那不起眼之维护的倾向。他们警告各省存在一种（狭隘地方性的/parochial）漂移、一种可能（萎缩/shrink）民族精神的（排外抱团的/clannish）地方主义。他们还注意到某些地方（懒散漫不经心的/lackadaisical）公民教育，把元帅的时代当作（杜撰存疑的/apocryphal）神话、而非（实证的/empirical）历史来讲授——一个（关键严重的/critical）缺失，因为一群把暴政当作童话来对待的人民，最有可能在它真正的考验中（不及格/flunk)。

值得回想一下，一如这场审计所做的，元帅究竟是个什么东西。他是一个披着（帝王般/regal）戏服的（江湖骗子/mountebank)、一个一人组成的（恶魔般的/diabolical）（阴谋集团/cabal)，他每一道（教皇般煞有介事的/pontifical）法令，在其（招摇炫耀/swank）之下都（荒唐无稽/nonsensical)。他的统治建立在一个（个人崇拜/cult）之上——一个（怀有敌意/inimical)、（病态的/pathological）东西——裹着（正典权威/canonical)、（普世教会般的/ecumenical）辞令，以显得神圣。他会像一个（狭隘的/parochial）小学校长那样（打屁股惩戒/spank）异见、（回避/shirk）一切问责、并（废除/repeal）任何刺痛他虚荣心的法律。他在每一个广场上为自己竖起一座（方尖碑/obelisk)，每一座都盖着一个标着虚假成就的（星号/asterisk)。

取而代之的这个共和国，相比之下，几乎是带着几分倔强的寻常。它的领导者们不佩戴自我荣耀的（奖章/medal)；他们朴素地（骑车/pedal）上班，经过市集的（售货亭/kiosk)。权力已被弄得（机械化/mechanical）而（条理缜密/methodical)，被（正典权威的/canonical）规则、而非（异想天开的/whimsical）意志所约束。没有哪个（元帅/marshal）能再次把这个国家变成他的（子承父业的/filial）遗产或他的（婚姻的/connubial）嫁妆。（夫妻间的/conjugal）事务与官方事务被（垂直地/vertical）分开；没有哪个领袖能（废除/repeal）宪法，去给他自己（直系的/lineal）继承人加冕。

这场审计的建议（零零碎碎/piecemeal）而务实。翻新公民教育，免得年轻人对错误的东西心生（怀疑/sceptical)。提防那些把一个（共同体/commonwealth）撕扯开来的（离心的/centrifugal）力量。让法庭保持（具批判性/critical)、新闻界保持自由、选举保持洁净。抵御那个对法治（使眼色暗中放水/winks）的（江湖骗子/mountebank)、和那个（招摇炫耀地/swank）（吠叫/barks）出轻巧答案的民粹主义者。最要紧的是，把自由当作一个（实证的/empirical)、可维护的事实，而非一个飘在触不可及之处的（缥缈/ethereal）或（遥远如星辰般的/sidereal）抽象概念。

账册之外，这个国家照旧做着它（和蔼亲切/genial）的营生。一个匠人为一座修复的厅堂雕着（镂空格饰/fretwork)；一个农夫在（售货亭/kiosk）旁分拣（谷物/cereal）和（燕麦片/oatmeal)；一只（花栗鼠/chipmunk）和一只大胆的（臭鼬/skunk）突袭着一座果园（树木丛生的/arboreal）边缘，孩子们笑成一团。一位（异想天开的/whimsical）诗人在广场上吟诵一首（牧歌/madrigal)；一位老（凉鞋/sandal）匠人，（不吝惜挥洒/prodigal）他的时间，把手艺传授给一个（恭顺的/filial）学徒。这个共和国的生活既不（帝王般/regal）也不（葬礼般阴郁/funereal)，而是平实、（怡然相宜地/congenial）属人的。

不可避免地，有人不认同这场审计。一个（好辩论战的/polemical）派系把它称作（狭隘的/parochial）吹毛求疵；一个（异端的/heretical）民粹主义者把它斥为一个精英（阴谋集团/cabal）的杰作，满是（口头上的/verbal）小聪明、却没有半点（胆识勇气/spunk)。他巴不得（废除/repeal）它的发现、（回避/shirk）它的警告、并把这个共和国（卸载送上岸/debark）到强人统治那古老、（恶魔般的/diabolical）的岸边。但公众，对他这江湖骗子的（招摇炫耀/swank）（心存怀疑/sceptical)，拒绝在审计员们设下的考验中（不及格/flunk)。他们读了这份报告、掂量了它（具批判性的/critical）眼光、并发现它与他们自己（基于实证的/empirical）判断相（契合亲和/cordial)。

于是韦尔莫利亚，自由了七十载，连它的种种凯旋也交付（审慎挑剔的/critical）审视。它一概拒绝那种完美记录的（杜撰存疑的/apocryphal）安慰、和那种虚假衰落的（葬礼般阴郁的/funereal）愁云。元帅曾力图成为一个超越一切审计的（帝王般/regal)、（无形非肉身的/incorporeal）理想；他的国家选择了相反的东西——诚实地清点它的缺陷、以（零零碎碎/piecemeal）的善意去（治愈/heal）它所能治愈的、并把它自己的自由不当作一份（天界般/empyreal）的馈赠、而当作一种（实证的/empirical)、（条理缜密的/methodical)、可无尽更新的习性。审计员们的结论是：一个共和国永远不会完成，也永远不是（单义定论的/univocal)；它之所以存续，恰恰是因为它愿意——每隔七十年或七年——对任何事都不（疏忽放过/overlook)、对任何关于自身的难题都不（回避推诿/shirk)。

本批词根亮点：

• -escent 家族：nascent（新生）/adolescent（青少年=正在成长）/obsolescent（正在过时）/evanescent（消逝）/iridescent（彩虹色），全表示"正在变化中"的进行状态

• salient/resilient：都来自 salire（跳），salient=跳出来=显著，resilient=跳回来=有弹性

• sapient/Homo sapiens：来自拉丁语"品尝"（sapere），能品味知识=智慧，智人=智慧的人

• indolent：in（否定）+ dolor（痛苦），不感到痛苦=懒洋洋，condolences（哀悼）同根

• reticent：和 reticulate（网状的）同根，被网住了嘴=沉默寡言

• fluorescent：来自萤石（fluorspar）的荧光效应

• piquant/picket：都来自"刺"，piquant=有刺激性=辛辣，picket=尖桩/警戒线

quiz.question: ____ bulk
quiz.explanation: 大量, 运送大量货物. The company will ship bulk orders overseas. 公司将把大量订单运送到海外。 | bulk->膨胀的大量（古Norse bulki->货物），in bulk->大批量地 || 文化联想：义乌小商品常按整箱、整批出货，最适合帮助记忆 bulk，可以说 **buy in bulk — “A wholesaler in Yiwu may buy in bulk and ship hundreds of identical items at once.”**

quiz.question: _______ hulk
quiz.explanation: 废船, 生锈的废船. A rusting hulk lay abandoned in the harbor. 一艘生锈的废船被遗弃在港口。 | hulk->庞大的东西，hulk->废弃的大船/魁梧的人（cf. Hulk绿巨人） || 文化联想：老港口里一艘废弃货轮锈迹斑斑，最适合帮助记忆 hulk，可以说 **a rusting hulk — “An abandoned cargo ship left for years beside the dock may become a rusting hulk.”**

quiz.question: _____ mountebank
quiz.explanation: 江湖骗子, 江湖骗子医生. The quack mountebank sold fake remedies. 江湖骗子医生出售假药。 | mount->爬上，bank->长凳，mountebank->爬上长凳叫卖的人=江湖骗子 || 文化联想：中文“江湖郎中卖假药”最适合帮助记忆 mountebank，可以说 **a quack mountebank — “A fake healer who stands in a market selling miracle cures may be exposed as a quack mountebank.”**

quiz.question: spank _ _____
quiz.explanation: 打屁股, 打孩子屁股. Parents debated whether to spank a child for misbehavior. 父母就是否因不当行为打孩子屁股而争论。 | spank->拍打（象声词），spanking->崭新的/打屁股 || 文化联想：旧式家庭教育里“打屁股”曾是常见体罚方式，这个场景最适合帮助记忆 spank，可以说 **spank a child — “In older family stories, an angry parent might threaten to spank a child for serious misbehavior.”**

quiz.question: swank _____
quiz.explanation: 豪华的, 豪华酒店. They stayed at a swank hotel in Manhattan. 他们住在曼哈顿的一家豪华酒店。 | swank->炫耀/豪华，swanky->时髦豪华的 || 文化联想：老上海豪华饭店灯火辉煌、装修气派的形象很适合联想到 swank，可以说 **a swank hotel — “A wealthy visitor to old Shanghai might choose a swank hotel with an ornate lobby and expensive dining room.”**

quiz.question: shrink __ ____
quiz.explanation: 畏缩, 畏缩恐惧. The timid child would shrink in fear from strangers. 胆小的孩子会因陌生人而畏缩恐惧。 | shrink->收缩/畏缩，shrink->精神科医生（俚语，因为分析人的内心） || 文化联想：中文“吓得往后缩”最适合帮助记忆 shrink，可以说 **shrink in fear — “A timid child may shrink in fear when a huge lion-dance head suddenly lunges toward him.”**

quiz.question: wink __
quiz.explanation: 眨眼, 对...眨眼. He would wink at her across the room. 他会从房间对面对她眨眼。 | wink->眨眼，wink at->眨眼示意/默许（cf. forty winks小睡） || 文化联想：中文“眉来眼去”最适合帮助记忆 wink，可以说 **wink at someone — “Across a crowded family banquet, one cousin may wink at another to share a private joke.”**

quiz.question: _ hunk __ _____
quiz.explanation: 大块, 一大块面包. He tore off a hunk of bread from the loaf. 他从面包上撕下一大块。 | hunk->大块/肌肉男（俚语），a hunk of->一大块 || 文化联想：新疆馕很适合帮助记忆 hunk，因为可以掰下一大块来吃，可以说 **a hunk of bread — “A traveler may tear a hunk of bread from a large naan and eat it with lamb or tea.”**

quiz.question: _ chunk __ ___
quiz.explanation: 厚块, 一大块冰. A chunk of ice broke off from the glacier. 一大块冰从冰川上断裂。 | chunk->厚重的一块（cf. hunk大块，chunk更强调厚实） || 文化联想：哈尔滨冬季松花江上的大冰块最适合帮助记忆 chunk，可以说 **a chunk of ice — “During a Harbin winter, a thick chunk of ice can be cut from the frozen river for an ice sculpture.”**

quiz.question: _______ skunk
quiz.explanation: 臭鼬, 条纹臭鼬. The striped skunk is known for its defensive spray. 条纹臭鼬以其防御性喷雾而闻名。 | skunk->臭鼬（来自美洲原住民语），drunk as a skunk->烂醉如泥 || 文化联想：skunk 并非中国本土动物，可用中国动物园里的北美臭鼬来记忆，可以说 **a striped skunk — “At a zoo in China, visitors may learn that a striped skunk defends itself by spraying a powerful odor.”**

quiz.question: flunk _ ____
quiz.explanation: 不及格, 考试不及格. Students who don't study may flunk a test. 不学习的学生可能会考试不及格。 | flunk->失败（可能源自funk->退缩），flunk out->因成绩差被退学 || 文化联想：中文“考试挂科”最适合帮助记忆 flunk，可以说 **flunk a test — “A student who barely studies for an important exam may flunk the test—也就是中文常说的‘挂科.’”**

quiz.question: chipmunk _____
quiz.explanation: 花栗鼠, 花栗鼠脸颊. The chipmunk cheek bulged with stored nuts. 花栗鼠脸颊因储存的坚果而鼓起。 | chip->条纹，munk->松鼠，chipmunk->有条纹的松鼠=花栗鼠 || 文化联想：中国东北也能见到花栗鼠，鼓鼓的脸颊最适合帮助记忆 chipmunk，可以说 **a chipmunk cheek — “A chipmunk in a northeastern forest may stuff seeds into its cheek until the side of its face bulges.”**

quiz.question: ____ spunk
quiz.explanation: 勇气, 展现勇气. The underdog team continued to show spunk. 处于劣势的球队继续展现勇气。 | spunk->火绒/勇气（苏格兰语），spunky->勇敢有活力的 || 文化联想：“初生牛犊不怕虎”最适合帮助记忆 spunk，可以说 **show spunk — “A young underdog who keeps challenging a much stronger opponent can show spunk—like a newborn calf unafraid of a tiger.”**

quiz.question: overlook _ ______
quiz.explanation: 忽略, 忽略细节. It's easy to overlook a detail in complex documents. 在复杂文件中很容易忽略细节。 | over->在上，look->看，overlook->从上俯视/忽略（一词两义） || 文化联想：中文“百密一疏”最适合帮助记忆 overlook，可以说 **overlook a detail — “Even a careful reviewer can overlook a detail in a long contract—‘百密一疏.’”**

quiz.question: brook __ _______
quiz.explanation: 容忍, 不容忍异议. The dictator would brook no dissent from subordinates. 独裁者不会容忍下属的异议。 | brook->小溪/容忍（反义同词），brook no->无法容忍 || 文化联想：包公“眼里揉不得沙子”的文化形象很适合帮助记忆 brook，可以说 **brook no corruption — “In popular stories, Bao Zheng would brook no corruption from officials under his authority.”**

quiz.question: bark ______
quiz.explanation: 吠叫, 大声吠叫. The guard dog would bark loudly at intruders. 看门狗会对入侵者大声吠叫。 | bark->树皮/吠叫/小船（一词多义），barking up the wrong tree->找错对象 || 文化联想：农村院子里的看门狗见到陌生人会大声叫，最适合帮助记忆 bark，可以说 **bark loudly — “A village guard dog may bark loudly when a stranger approaches the gate at night.”**

quiz.question: debark __________
quiz.explanation: 下船, 让乘客下船. The crew prepared to debark passengers at the port. 船员准备在港口让乘客下船。 | de->离开，bark->小船，debark->离开船=下船（cf. embark上船） || 文化联想：上海或厦门邮轮靠港后乘客下船的场景最适合帮助记忆 debark，可以说 **debark passengers — “When a cruise ship reaches a Chinese port, the crew may debark passengers after customs procedures are ready.”**

quiz.question: _____ hallmark
quiz.explanation: 特征, 品牌特征. Quality is the brand hallmark of luxury goods. 质量是奢侈品的品牌特征。 | hall->金匠公会大厅，mark->标记，hallmark->公会认证标记=品质特征 || 文化联想：景德镇瓷器讲究胎、釉、火候和做工，最适合帮助记忆 hallmark，可以说 **a hallmark of quality — “Fine glaze and careful firing are a hallmark of quality in high-grade Jingdezhen porcelain.”**

quiz.question: spark ________
quiz.explanation: 激发, 激发兴趣. The discovery helped spark interest in ancient history. 这一发现帮助激发了对古代历史的兴趣。 | spark->火花，spark interest->点燃兴趣的火花 || 文化联想：三星堆新发现常能激起公众对古代文明的兴趣，最适合帮助记忆 spark，可以说 **spark interest — “A newly unearthed Sanxingdui artifact can spark interest in Bronze Age history among young visitors.”**

quiz.question: stark ________
quiz.explanation: 明显的, 明显的对比. The two paintings showed a stark contrast in style. 这两幅画在风格上显示出明显的对比。 | stark->僵硬/完全（古英语），stark contrast->鲜明对比，stark naked->赤裸裸 || 文化联想：江南水乡与西北戈壁形成极鲜明的景观对比，最适合帮助记忆 stark，可以说 **a stark contrast — “Green canals and stone bridges in Jiangnan form a stark contrast with the dry expanses of the Gobi.”**

quiz.question: ______ jerk
quiz.explanation: 猛拉, 突然的猛拉. The train stopped with a sudden jerk. 火车突然猛拉一下停了下来。 | jerk->猛拉/蠢货（俚语），beef jerky->牛肉干（晒干时反复拉扯） || 文化联想：老式绿皮火车突然启动或刹车时身体会猛地一晃，最适合帮助记忆 jerk，可以说 **a sudden jerk — “An old train may start with a sudden jerk that makes standing passengers grab the rail.”**

quiz.question: shirk ______________
quiz.explanation: 逃避, 逃避责任. Good leaders never shirk responsibility for mistakes. 好的领导者从不逃避责任的错误。 | shirk->回避/逃避（cf. shark鲨鱼，同音联想：像鲨鱼一样滑走） || 文化联想：中文“推卸责任”最适合帮助记忆 shirk，可以说 **shirk responsibility — “A manager who blames subordinates for every mistake is trying to shirk responsibility.”**

quiz.question: quirk __ ____
quiz.explanation: 怪癖, 命运的怪癖. Meeting her again was a strange quirk of fate. 再次遇见她是命运的怪癖。 | quirk->扭曲/怪癖，quirky->古怪有个性的（cf. queer奇怪） || 文化联想：中文常说“缘分真奇妙”，很适合帮助记忆 quirk，可以说 **a quirk of fate — “Two childhood classmates meeting again decades later in another city can feel like a quirk of fate.”**

quiz.question: ____ fretwork
quiz.explanation: 回纹细工, 花边回纹细工. The dress featured delicate lace fretwork. 这件连衣裙以精致的花边回纹细工为特色。 | fret->焦虑/镂空装饰，fretwork->镂空装饰细工 || 文化联想：苏州园林的漏窗和木雕镂空纹样最适合帮助记忆 fretwork，可以说 **delicate fretwork — “A classical Suzhou garden may feature delicate fretwork in wooden screens and decorative windows.”**

quiz.question: _____ obelisk
quiz.explanation: 方尖碑, 石方尖碑. The ancient stone obelisk stood in the plaza. 古老的石方尖碑矗立在广场上。 | obelos->烤肉扦（希腊），obelisk->扦形石柱=方尖碑 || 文化联想：obelisk 是西方和古埃及常见的纪念性形式，可用中国博物馆讲解外国古迹的场景来记忆，可以说 **a stone obelisk — “In a Chinese museum exhibition on ancient Egypt, visitors may see a model of a tall stone obelisk.”**

quiz.question: ________ asterisk
quiz.explanation: 星号, 脚注星号. A footnote asterisk marked additional information. 脚注星号标记了额外信息。 | aster->星星（希腊），asterisk->小星星=星号（cf. asteroid小行星，astronomy天文学） || 文化联想：中国论文和合同里常用星号引出补充说明，最适合帮助记忆 asterisk，可以说 **an asterisk footnote — “A legal document may place an asterisk beside a term and explain the exception in a footnote below.”**

quiz.question: ______ kiosk
quiz.explanation: 售货亭, 售票亭. Passengers bought tickets at the ticket kiosk. 乘客在售票亭购买票。 | köşk->凉亭（土耳其语），kiosk->小亭子=售货亭 || 文化联想：中国高铁站里的自助售票机和服务小亭最适合帮助记忆 kiosk，可以说 **a ticket kiosk — “A passenger at a railway station may collect or inquire about a ticket at a self-service kiosk.”**

quiz.question: ____ husk
quiz.explanation: 外壳, 玉米外壳. Remove the corn husk before cooking. 烹饪前去除玉米外壳。 | husk->外壳/嘶哑，husky->声音嘶哑的/哈士奇（厚皮毛） || 文化联想：东北秋收时剥去玉米外面的皮，最适合帮助记忆 husk，可以说 **a corn husk — “After harvesting maize, a farmer peels away the corn husk before drying or storing the ears.”**

quiz.question: ________ tusk
quiz.explanation: 象牙, 大象象牙. Poachers illegally hunt elephant tusk. 偷猎者非法猎取大象象牙。 | tusk->长牙（古英语tusc），tusk->象牙/野猪獠牙 || 文化联想：云南亚洲象最适合帮助记忆 tusk，可以说 **an elephant tusk — “A wild Asian elephant in Yunnan may have an ivory tusk projecting from either side of its trunk.”**

quiz.question: hawk _ _______
quiz.explanation: 兜售, 兜售产品. Vendors would hawk a product on street corners. 小贩会在街角兜售产品。 | hawk->鹰/兜售/清喉咙（一词三义），hawker->小贩 || 文化联想：庙会和老街上小贩高声叫卖商品的画面最适合帮助记忆 hawk，可以说 **hawk a product — “At a crowded temple fair, a vendor may hawk a product by calling out its price and benefits to passersby.”**

quiz.question: ______ cabal
quiz.explanation: 阴谋集团, 秘密阴谋集团. A secret cabal plotted to overthrow the government. 一个秘密阴谋集团密谋推翻政府。 | cabala->犹太神秘教义（秘密传授），cabal->秘密小团体=阴谋集团 || 文化联想：中文“朋党密谋”最适合帮助记忆 cabal，可以说 **a secret cabal — “A small group of court insiders meeting privately to manipulate appointments could be described as a secret cabal.”**

quiz.question: verbal _____
quiz.explanation: 言语的, 言语虐待. The employee suffered verbal abuse from the supervisor. 员工遭受主管的言语虐待。 | verb->词/动词，verbal->言语的（cf. verbose冗长的，verbatim逐字的） || 文化联想：“恶语伤人六月寒”最适合帮助记忆 verbal，可以说 **verbal abuse — “The saying ‘cruel words can chill even in June’ captures how verbal abuse can wound someone deeply.”**

quiz.question: methodical ________
quiz.explanation: 有条理的, 有条理的方法. The scientist used a methodical approach to research. 科学家使用有条理的方法进行研究。 | method->方法，methodical->按方法来的=有条理的（cf. methodology方法论） || 文化联想：李时珍长期搜集、核对并分类药物资料的形象很适合帮助记忆 methodical，可以说 **a methodical approach — “Compiling a vast materia medica required a methodical approach to collecting, comparing, and organizing information.”**

quiz.question: ________ periodical
quiz.explanation: 期刊, 学术期刊. The professor published in an academic periodical. 教授在学术期刊上发表文章。 | period->周期，periodical->定期出版的=期刊（cf. periodic定期的） || 文化联想：《新青年》是中国近代史上非常著名的定期刊物，最适合帮助记忆 periodical，可以说 **an influential periodical — “New Youth became an influential periodical in early twentieth-century Chinese intellectual life.”**

quiz.question: pontifical ____
quiz.explanation: 自以为是的, 自以为是的语气. His pontifical tone annoyed colleagues. 他自以为是的语气惹恼了同事。 | pontiff->教皇，pontifical->教皇般的=自以为是的（cf. pontificate高谈阔论） || 文化联想：中文“摆出一副权威口吻”最适合帮助记忆 pontifical，可以说 **a pontifical tone — “An old scholar who speaks as though no one else could possibly be right may adopt a pontifical tone.”**

quiz.question: pathological ____
quiz.explanation: 病态的, 病态的说谎者. The pathological liar couldn't distinguish truth from fiction. 病态的说谎者无法区分真假。 | patho->疾病，log->研究，pathological->病理学的/病态的（cf. pathology病理学） || 文化联想：中文“谎话张口就来”最适合帮助记忆 pathological，可以说 **a pathological liar — “Someone who lies constantly even when there is nothing to gain may be described as a pathological liar.”**

quiz.question: physiological ________
quiz.explanation: 生理的, 生理反应. Fear triggers a physiological response in the body. 恐惧在身体中触发生理反应。 | physio->自然/身体，log->研究，physiological->生理学的（cf. physician医生） || 文化联想：被老师突然点名后心跳加快、手心出汗，是 physiological 最直观的场景，可以说 **a physiological response — “A nervous student called on in class may experience a physiological response such as a faster heartbeat and sweaty palms.”**

quiz.question: tautological ____
quiz.explanation: 同义反复的, 同义反复的循环. The argument fell into a tautological loop. 论证陷入了同义反复的循环。 | tauto->同样（希腊），log->说，tautological->说同样的话=同义反复的 || 文化联想：中文“因为成功所以成功”这种循环论证最适合帮助记忆 tautological，可以说 **a tautological loop — “Saying ‘the policy works because it is successful’ traps the argument in a tautological loop.”**

quiz.question: typographical _____
quiz.explanation: 排版的, 排版错误. The book contained several typographical error. 这本书包含几处排版错误。 | typo->字模，graph->写，typographical->印刷排版的（typo是typographical error的缩写） || 文化联想：中文书籍里把一个字排错、漏字或多字，最适合帮助记忆 typographical，可以说 **a typographical error — “A newly printed Chinese book may contain a typographical error such as a missing character or misplaced punctuation mark.”**

quiz.question: cyclical ________
quiz.explanation: 周期性的, 周期性衰退. The economy experienced a cyclical downturn. 经济经历了周期性衰退。 | cycl->圆/循环，cyclical->循环的（cf. bicycle自行车，recycle循环） || 文化联想：中国人常说“猪周期”，最适合帮助记忆 cyclical，可以说 **a cyclical downturn — “Falling pork prices after a period of overexpansion can become part of a cyclical downturn in the hog industry.”**

quiz.question: diabolical ______
quiz.explanation: 恶魔般的, 恶魔般的阴谋. The villain hatched a diabolical scheme. 反派策划了一个恶魔般的阴谋。 | diablo->魔鬼（希腊diabolos->诽谤者），diabolical->魔鬼般的（cf. devil魔鬼） || 文化联想：古装剧里反派设计一套极其狠毒的阴谋，最适合帮助记忆 diabolical，可以说 **a diabolical scheme — “A villain who plans to frame an entire innocent family may be carrying out a diabolical scheme.”**

quiz.question: polemical _____
quiz.explanation: 论战的, 论战性文章. The author wrote a polemical essay on politics. 作者写了一篇关于政治的论战性文章。 | polemos->战争（希腊），polemical->战斗性的=论战的（cf. polemic论战） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文中不少篇章带有鲜明论战性，最适合帮助记忆 polemical，可以说 **a polemical essay — “A sharply argued essay attacking hypocrisy and social convention can be a polemical essay in the spirit of modern Chinese literary debate.”**

quiz.question: inimical __ ______
quiz.explanation: 有害的, 对健康有害的. Smoking is inimical to health. 吸烟对健康有害。 | in->否定，amic->友好，inimical->不友好的=有害的（cf. enemy敌人，amicable友好的） || 文化联想：雾霾和长期吸烟都对健康有害，最适合帮助记忆 inimical，可以说 **inimical to health — “Heavy air pollution is inimical to health because prolonged exposure can damage the respiratory system.”**

quiz.question: economical ___
quiz.explanation: 经济的, 经济型汽车. The economical car saves money on fuel. 经济型汽车节省燃料费用。 | eco->家/管理，nom->法则，economical->节省管理的=经济实惠的（注意区分economic经济学的） || 文化联想：中文“省油省钱的小车”最适合帮助记忆 economical，可以说 **an economical car — “A family choosing a small fuel-efficient vehicle may prefer an economical car that costs less to run.”**

quiz.question: astronomical _____
quiz.explanation: 天文数字的, 天文数字的价格. The artwork sold for an astronomical price. 这件艺术品以天文数字的价格售出。 | astro->星星，nom->法则，astronomical->天文学的/天文数字般巨大的 || 文化联想：一线城市一套豪宅卖出“天价”，最适合帮助记忆 astronomical，可以说 **an astronomical price — “A rare luxury apartment in a prime district may sell for an astronomical price that ordinary buyers cannot imagine paying.”**

quiz.question: anatomical _____
quiz.explanation: 解剖的, 解剖模型. Medical students studied the anatomical model. 医学生研究解剖模型。 | ana->向上，tom->切，anatomical->切开研究的=解剖的（cf. atom原子=不可再切的） || 文化联想：中国医学院学生利用人体模型学习器官位置，最适合帮助记忆 anatomical，可以说 **an anatomical model — “Medical students may use an anatomical model to study the relative positions of the heart, lungs, liver, and other organs.”**

quiz.question: mechanical _______
quiz.explanation: 机械的, 机械故障. The plane crash was caused by mechanical failure. 飞机坠毁是由机械故障引起的。 | mechan->机械，mechanical->机械的/机械式的（cf. mechanism机制） || 文化联想：工厂生产线因为轴承或齿轮损坏而停机，最适合帮助记忆 mechanical，可以说 **a mechanical failure — “A broken bearing in a factory machine can cause a mechanical failure that stops the entire production line.”**

quiz.question: ecumenical _______
quiz.explanation: 普世的, 普世会议. The ecumenical council brought together different faiths. 普世会议汇集了不同的信仰。 | oikoumene->整个居住世界（希腊），ecumenical->全基督教世界的=普世的 || 文化联想：ecumenical 是基督宗教内部跨教派合作的概念，可用中国基督徒参加跨教派交流的场景来记忆，可以说 **an ecumenical gathering — “Christians from different denominations in China may join an ecumenical gathering focused on shared prayer or social service.”**

quiz.question: canonical ____
quiz.explanation: 经典的, 经典文本. Shakespeare's works are canonical text in English literature. 莎士比亚的作品是英国文学的经典文本。 | canon->教规/经典（希腊kanon->直尺），canonical->符合经典标准的 || 文化联想：儒家的“四书五经”最适合帮助记忆 canonical，可以说 **a canonical text — “For generations, the Confucian classics were treated as canonical texts central to elite education and the examination tradition.”**

quiz.question: empirical ________
quiz.explanation: 经验的, 经验证据. The theory was supported by empirical evidence. 该理论得到经验证据的支持。 | empiri->经验（希腊peira->尝试），empirical->基于实际经验的（cf. empiricism经验主义） || 文化联想：中国农民做田间对照试验、比较不同种植方法的结果，最适合帮助记忆 empirical，可以说 **empirical evidence — “Comparing crop yields from two farming methods can provide empirical evidence about which method works better.”**

quiz.question: metrical _______
quiz.explanation: 韵律的, 韵律模式. The poem followed a strict metrical pattern. 这首诗遵循严格的韵律模式。 | metr->度量/节拍，metrical->按节拍度量的=韵律的（cf. meter米/节拍） || 文化联想：唐诗近体诗讲究严格的字数、平仄和节奏，最适合帮助记忆 metrical，可以说 **a metrical pattern — “A regulated Tang poem follows a strict metrical pattern involving line length, tonal arrangement, and rhythm.”**

quiz.question: lackadaisical ________
quiz.explanation: 懒散的, 懒散的态度. His lackadaisical attitude toward work was problematic. 他对工作懒散的态度是有问题的。 | lackaday->哎呀（感叹无聊），lackadaisical->无精打采懒洋洋的 || 文化联想：中文“当一天和尚撞一天钟”最适合帮助记忆 lackadaisical，可以说 **a lackadaisical attitude — “Someone who merely ‘rings the bell for another day’ may show a lackadaisical attitude toward work.”**

quiz.question: whimsical ____
quiz.explanation: 异想天开的, 异想天开的想法. The artist had a whimsical idea for the sculpture. 艺术家对雕塑有一个异想天开的想法。 | whim->突发奇想，whimsical->充满奇思妙想的=异想天开的 || 文化联想：孙悟空七十二变那种天马行空的想象力最适合帮助记忆 whimsical，可以说 **a whimsical idea — “A children’s illustrator may have a whimsical idea of showing Sun Wukong riding a cloud through a modern city.”**

quiz.question: nonsensical ______
quiz.explanation: 荒谬的, 荒谬的评论. He dismissed the proposal as a nonsensical remark. 他将该提议视为荒谬的评论而不予理会。 | non->否定，sense->意义，nonsensical->毫无意义的=荒谬的 || 文化联想：中文“驴唇不对马嘴”最适合帮助记忆 nonsensical，可以说 **a nonsensical remark — “An answer that has nothing to do with the question may sound like a nonsensical remark—‘驴唇不对马嘴.’”**

quiz.question: metaphysical ________
quiz.explanation: 形而上学的, 形而上学问题. Philosophers debate metaphysical question about existence. 哲学家辩论关于存在的形而上学问题。 | meta->在…之后/超越，physic->自然，metaphysical->超越物理的=形而上学的 || 文化联想：宋明理学对“理”“气”“性”等问题的讨论很适合帮助记忆 metaphysical，可以说 **a metaphysical question — “A Neo-Confucian thinker asking how ‘li’ and ‘qi’ relate is addressing a metaphysical question about the structure of reality.”**

quiz.question: alphabetical _____
quiz.explanation: 按字母顺序的, 按字母顺序. The dictionary lists words in alphabetical order. 字典按字母顺序列出单词。 | alpha+beta->希腊字母前两个，alphabetical->按字母表顺序的 || 文化联想：汉语拼音词典常按拉丁字母顺序排列词条，最适合帮助记忆 alphabetical，可以说 **alphabetical order — “A pinyin index may list Chinese entries in alphabetical order from A through Z.”**

quiz.question: hypothetical ________
quiz.explanation: 假设的, 假设的情景. The professor presented a hypothetical scenario. 教授提出了一个假设的情景。 | hypo->在下/假设，thes->放置，hypothetical->放在下面作基础的=假设的（cf. hypothesis假说） || 文化联想：历史课上讨论“如果赤壁之战结果相反会怎样”最适合帮助记忆 hypothetical，可以说 **a hypothetical scenario — “A teacher may ask students to consider a hypothetical scenario in which Cao Cao had won the Battle of Red Cliffs.”**

quiz.question: heretical ____
quiz.explanation: 异端的, 异端观点. The church condemned his heretical view. 教会谴责了他的异端观点。 | hairein->选择（希腊），heretical->自己选择信仰而非遵从教义=异端的（cf. heresy异端） || 文化联想：中文“离经叛道”可以帮助记忆 heretical，但它与宗教异端并不完全等同，可以说 **a heretical view — “A thinker who openly rejects an established orthodoxy may be accused of holding a heretical view—something Chinese readers may compare with ‘离经叛道.’”**

quiz.question: theoretical _________
quiz.explanation: 理论的, 理论框架. The study employed a strong theoretical framework. 该研究采用了强大的理论框架。 | theor->观察（希腊），theoretical->基于观察推论的=理论的（cf. theater剧场，theory理论） || 文化联想：儒家关于仁、礼和社会秩序的思想可以作为一种理论框架来讨论，最适合帮助记忆 theoretical，可以说 **a theoretical framework — “A scholar may use Confucian ideas about benevolence and ritual as a theoretical framework for analyzing traditional social relations.”**

quiz.question: critical _________
quiz.explanation: 危急的, 危急状况. The patient remained in critical condition. 患者仍处于危急状况。 | crit->判断（希腊），critical->做出判断的关键时刻=危急的/批判的（cf. criterion标准） || 文化联想：中文医院里的“病危”最适合帮助记忆 critical，可以说 **a critical condition — “A patient in a critical condition may require continuous monitoring and intensive medical support.”**

quiz.question: sceptical ____
quiz.explanation: 怀疑的, 怀疑的观点. Scientists took a sceptical view of the claims. 科学家对这些声明持怀疑的观点。 | skept->考察（希腊），sceptical->不断考察质疑的=怀疑的（cf. skeptic怀疑者） || 文化联想：“耳听为虚，眼见为实”最适合帮助记忆 sceptical，可以说 **a sceptical view — “The saying ‘hearing is uncertain, seeing is believing’ encourages a sceptical view of claims that lack evidence.”**

quiz.question: elliptical _____
quiz.explanation: 椭圆的, 椭圆轨道. Planets follow an elliptical orbit around the sun. 行星沿着围绕太阳的椭圆轨道运行。 | elleipsis->缺失（希腊），ellipse->缺了一角的圆=椭圆，elliptical->椭圆的/省略的 || 文化联想：中国探月工程中的航天器会使用不同形状的轨道，最适合帮助记忆 elliptical，可以说 **an elliptical orbit — “A spacecraft can travel around the Moon in an elliptical orbit rather than a perfectly circular one.”**

quiz.question: vertical ____
quiz.explanation: 垂直的, 垂直轴. The graph shows data along the vertical axis. 图表沿垂直轴显示数据。 | vert->转/顶点（拉丁vertex），vertical->从顶点向下的=垂直的（cf. vertex顶点） || 文化联想：中国中学数学坐标系里的纵轴最适合帮助记忆 vertical，可以说 **a vertical axis — “On a classroom graph, the y-axis is the vertical axis running from bottom to top.”**

quiz.question: nautical _____
quiz.explanation: 航海的, 航海图. Sailors navigate using a nautical chart. 水手使用航海图导航。 | naut->船/水手（希腊），nautical->航海的（cf. astronaut宇航员，cosmonaut宇航员） || 文化联想：郑和时代的航海需要辨认海岸、航道和方位，最适合帮助记忆 nautical，可以说 **a nautical chart — “A navigator sailing along the Chinese coast may use a nautical chart to identify depths, hazards, and safe routes.”**

quiz.question: pharmaceutical _______
quiz.explanation: 制药的, 制药公司. The pharmaceutical company developed new treatments. 制药公司开发了新的治疗方法。 | pharmak->药物（希腊），pharmaceutical->制药的（cf. pharmacy药店） || 文化联想：中国药企研发和生产药品的现代场景最适合帮助记忆 pharmaceutical，可以说 **a pharmaceutical company — “A pharmaceutical company may spend years testing and manufacturing a new medicine before it reaches patients.”**

quiz.question: lexical ____
quiz.explanation: 词汇的, 词汇项. The dictionary defines each lexical item precisely. 字典精确定义每个词汇项。 | lexis->词语（希腊），lexical->词汇的（cf. lexicon词典，dyslexia阅读障碍） || 文化联想：中文词典里“吃瓜”这样的词或词组都可以作为词汇单位来分析，最适合帮助记忆 lexical，可以说 **a lexical item — “In modern Chinese, a popular expression such as ‘吃瓜’ can be studied as a lexical item with a meaning beyond its literal characters.”**

quiz.question: reciprocal _______
quiz.explanation: 相互的, 相互尊重. Good relationships require reciprocal respect. 良好的关系需要相互尊重。 | recip->来回，proc->向前，reciprocal->来回往返的=相互的（cf. recipe食谱=收到的东西） || 文化联想：“礼尚往来”最适合帮助记忆 reciprocal，可以说 **reciprocal respect — “The idea of ‘礼尚往来’ encourages reciprocal respect and response rather than one-sided obligation.”**

quiz.question: univocal ____
quiz.explanation: 单义的, 单义术语. The scientific definition is a univocal term. 科学定义是一个单义术语。 | uni->一，voc->声音/意义，univocal->只有一种意义的=单义的（cf. equivocal模棱两可的） || 文化联想：合同里的关键术语最好只有一种明确解释，最适合帮助记忆 univocal，可以说 **a univocal term — “A well-drafted contract tries to use a univocal term when ambiguity could create a legal dispute.”**

quiz.question: ____ medal
quiz.explanation: 奖章, 金牌. The athlete won a gold medal at the Olympics. 运动员在奥运会上赢得了金牌。 | medal->金属片（拉丁metallum），medal->奖章（注意区分meddle干涉，同音） || 文化联想：中国奥运冠军站上领奖台领取金牌的画面最适合帮助记忆 medal，可以说 **a gold medal — “A Chinese athlete who wins an Olympic final may stand on the podium and receive a gold medal.”**

quiz.question: pedal _____
quiz.explanation: 踏板, 踏板动力. The bicycle runs on pedal power alone. 自行车仅靠踏板动力运行。 | ped->脚（拉丁），pedal->用脚踩的=踏板（cf. pedestrian行人，pedicure足疗） || 文化联想：共享单车完全靠骑车人踩踏提供动力，最适合帮助记忆 pedal，可以说 **pedal power — “A shared bicycle moves entirely through pedal power supplied by the rider’s legs.”**

quiz.question: _______ sandal
quiz.explanation: 凉鞋, 皮凉鞋. She wore comfortable leather sandal in summer. 她在夏天穿舒适的皮凉鞋。 | sandalon->凉鞋（希腊），sandal->凉鞋（cf. sandalwood檀香木，因制凉鞋） || 文化联想：丝绸之路考古中曾发现各种古代鞋履，可用皮凉鞋帮助记忆 sandal，可以说 **a leather sandal — “An ancient traveler crossing the dry northwest might wear a simple leather sandal suited to the climate.”**

quiz.question: heal ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 治愈, 治愈伤口. Time will help heal the wound both physically and emotionally. 时间将帮助治愈身体和情感上的伤口。 | heal->使完整（古英语hal->整全），heal->治愈（cf. health健康，whole完整） || 文化联想：武侠小说里的金创药常被描写为帮助伤口恢复，最适合帮助记忆 heal，可以说 **heal the wound — “In a wuxia story, a wounded swordsman may apply medicine and rest for days while the body begins to heal the wound.”**

quiz.question: piecemeal ______
quiz.explanation: 零碎的, 零碎的改革. The government implemented piecemeal reform instead of comprehensive change. 政府实施零碎的改革而不是全面改革。 | piece->片，meal->一次（古英语，量词），piecemeal->一片一片地=零碎的 || 文化联想：中文“头痛医头，脚痛医脚”最适合帮助记忆 piecemeal，可以说 **piecemeal reform — “Changing one small rule at a time without addressing the whole system can become piecemeal reform—‘头痛医头，脚痛医脚.’”**

quiz.question: oatmeal ________
quiz.explanation: 燕麦片, 燕麦片粥. She ate warm oatmeal porridge for breakfast. 她早餐吃温暖的燕麦片粥。 | oat->燕麦，meal->磨碎的谷物，oatmeal->磨碎的燕麦=燕麦片 || 文化联想：现代中国早餐里燕麦粥越来越常见，最适合帮助记忆 oatmeal，可以说 **oatmeal porridge — “A quick weekday breakfast may consist of warm oatmeal porridge topped with fruit or nuts.”**

quiz.question: lineal __________
quiz.explanation: 直系的, 直系后裔. He is a lineal descendant of the royal family. 他是王室的直系后裔。 | line->线，lineal->沿直线传承的=直系的（cf. linear线性的，lineage血统） || 文化联想：古代宗谱特别强调嫡系、直系后代，最适合帮助记忆 lineal，可以说 **a lineal descendant — “A clan genealogy may identify a person as a lineal descendant of an earlier ancestor through an unbroken family line.”**

quiz.question: repeal _ ___
quiz.explanation: 废除, 废除法律. Congress voted to repeal a law that was outdated. 国会投票废除一项过时的法律。 | re->回，peal->呼吁，repeal->撤回呼吁=废除（cf. appeal上诉/呼吁） || 文化联想：王朝更替后新政权废除旧法令，最适合帮助记忆 repeal，可以说 **repeal a law — “A new government may repeal a law that no longer fits the legal order it intends to establish.”**

quiz.question: ____ appeal
quiz.explanation: 呼吁, 发出呼吁. The charity will make appeal for donations. 慈善机构将发出捐款呼吁。 | ap->朝向，peal->呼喊，appeal->朝某人呼喊=呼吁/上诉（cf. repeal废除） || 文化联想：古代百姓“击鼓鸣冤”就是向官府正式申诉，最适合帮助记忆 appeal，可以说 **make an appeal — “A wronged villager who beats the drum outside the yamen is trying to make an appeal to the magistrate.”**

quiz.question: _________ cereal
quiz.explanation: 谷物, 早餐谷物. Children enjoy eating breakfast cereal with milk. 孩子们喜欢吃加牛奶的早餐谷物。 | Ceres->罗马谷物女神，cereal->谷物（注意区分serial连续的，同音） || 文化联想：水稻是中国最重要的谷类作物之一，最适合帮助记忆 cereal，可以说 **a cereal crop — “Rice is a major cereal crop in southern China and forms the staple food for hundreds of millions of people.”**

quiz.question: sidereal ____
quiz.explanation: 恒星的, 恒星时. Astronomers use sidereal time for observations. 天文学家使用恒星时进行观测。 | sider->星星（拉丁sidus），sidereal->星星的=恒星的（cf. consider->con+sider->观星=考虑） || 文化联想：现代中国天文台观测恒星时也会使用恒星时，最适合帮助记忆 sidereal，可以说 **sidereal time — “Astronomers at an observatory may use sidereal time to track the position of stars as Earth rotates.”**

quiz.question: ethereal ______
quiz.explanation: 飘渺的, 飘渺的美丽. The dancer possessed an ethereal beauty. 舞者拥有飘渺的美丽。 | ether->天空/以太（希腊），ethereal->天空般的=飘渺轻盈的（cf. ether乙醚） || 文化联想：敦煌飞天轻盈飘逸、仿佛不着尘世的形象最适合帮助记忆 ethereal，可以说 **ethereal beauty — “The floating ribbons and weightless poses of Dunhuang apsaras give the figures an ethereal beauty.”**

quiz.question: funereal ____
quiz.explanation: 阴郁的, 阴郁的气氛. A funereal mood settled over the gathering. 阴郁的气氛笼罩着聚会。 | funer->葬礼（拉丁），funereal->葬礼般阴沉的（cf. funeral葬礼） || 文化联想：清明祭扫时低沉肃穆的气氛最适合帮助记忆 funereal，可以说 **a funereal mood — “A memorial gathering at a family grave may take on a funereal mood as relatives stand quietly and remember the dead.”**

quiz.question: arboreal _______
quiz.explanation: 树栖的, 树栖栖息地. Monkeys thrive in their arboreal habitat. 猴子在它们的树栖栖息地中茁壮成长。 | arbor->树（拉丁），arboreal->树上生活的（cf. arboretum植物园） || 文化联想：川金丝猴大部分时间生活在树上，最适合帮助记忆 arboreal，可以说 **an arboreal habitat — “The golden snub-nosed monkey depends on an arboreal habitat in the mountain forests of central China.”**

quiz.question: incorporeal ______
quiz.explanation: 无形的, 无形的精神. Ghost stories speak of incorporeal spirit. 鬼故事讲述无形的精神。 | in->否定，corpor->身体，incorporeal->没有身体的=无形的（cf. corporal肉体的，incorporate合并） || 文化联想：《聊斋志异》里的鬼魂常被描写成没有实体的灵体，最适合帮助记忆 incorporeal，可以说 **an incorporeal spirit — “A ghost in Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio may appear as an incorporeal spirit that passes beyond ordinary physical limits.”**

quiz.question: empyreal _____
quiz.explanation: 天空的, 天空之光. The painting depicted empyreal light from heaven. 这幅画描绘了来自天堂的天空之光。 | empyr->火（希腊），empyreal->最高天的（cf. empyrean最高天） || 文化联想：empyreal 是西方文学中“天界般”的高雅词，可用中国古典诗文描写天宫霞光的场景来记忆，可以说 **empyreal light — “A poet imagining the heavenly palace above the clouds might describe it as glowing with empyreal light.”**

quiz.question: regal _______
quiz.explanation: 帝王的, 帝王气质. The queen maintained a regal bearing. 女王保持着帝王气质。 | reg->统治（拉丁rex->国王），regal->国王的（cf. reign统治，royal皇家的） || 文化联想：古装剧里武则天端坐朝堂、气势威严的形象很适合帮助记忆 regal，可以说 **regal bearing — “A portrayal of Empress Wu seated before the court may give her a regal bearing that commands immediate attention.”**

quiz.question: prodigal ___
quiz.explanation: 挥霍的, 浪子. The parable tells of the prodigal son who returned home. 寓言讲述了回家的浪子。 | pro->向前，dig->驱赶，prodigal->把财产都驱赶出去的=挥霍的（cf. prodigious巨大的） || 文化联想：“浪子回头金不换”最适合帮助记忆 prodigal，可以说 **a prodigal son — “The saying ‘a prodigal son who returns is worth more than gold’ celebrates someone who abandons a wasteful life and comes home changed.”**

quiz.question: ____ madrigal
quiz.explanation: 情歌, 爱情牧歌. The choir performed a beautiful love madrigal. 合唱团演唱了一首美丽的爱情牧歌。 | madrigal->田园情歌（意大利），多声部无伴奏合唱的世俗歌曲 || 文化联想：madrigal 是欧洲文艺复兴时期的声乐形式，可用中国音乐学院学习西方音乐史的场景来记忆，可以说 **a Renaissance madrigal — “Students in a Chinese conservatory may study a Renaissance madrigal while learning the history of European vocal music.”**

quiz.question: centrifugal _____
quiz.explanation: 离心的, 离心力. Centrifugal force pushes objects outward during rotation. 离心力在旋转期间将物体向外推。 | centri->中心，fug->逃离，centrifugal->逃离中心的=离心的（cf. centripetal向心的） || 文化联想：洗衣机高速脱水时衣物被甩向桶壁，是 centrifugal 最直观的生活场景，可以说 **centrifugal force — “During the spin cycle, centrifugal force pushes wet clothes outward against the wall of the washing-machine drum.”**

quiz.question: conjugal ______
quiz.explanation: 婚姻的, 婚姻权利. The couple discussed their conjugal rights. 这对夫妇讨论了他们的婚姻权利。 | con->共同，jug->结合（拉丁jugum->轭），conjugal->共同套上轭的=婚姻的（cf. conjugate结合） || 文化联想：传统婚姻观强调夫妻之间彼此承担责任，可以帮助记忆 conjugal，可以说 **conjugal duties — “In traditional discussions of marriage, spouses were expected to fulfill conjugal duties toward one another and the household.”**

quiz.question: apocryphal _____
quiz.explanation: 杜撰的, 杜撰的故事. The legend is probably an apocryphal story. 这个传说可能是一个杜撰的故事。 | apo->离开，crypt->隐藏，apocryphal->隐藏起来的（未被认可的）=杜撰的/伪经的 || 文化联想：中文“野史传闻”最适合帮助记忆 apocryphal，可以说 **an apocryphal story — “A dramatic tale about an emperor that appears only in later gossip and not reliable records may be an apocryphal story.”**

quiz.question: _____ marshal
quiz.explanation: 元帅, 陆军元帅. The field marshal commanded the entire army. 陆军元帅指挥整个军队。 | marah->马，scalc->仆人（古日耳曼），marshal->管马的人->指挥官=元帅 || 文化联想：1955年中华人民共和国授予十位高级将领“元帅”军衔，最适合帮助记忆 marshal，可以说 **a Chinese marshal — “Zhu De was one of the ten senior commanders awarded the rank of marshal in 1955.”**

quiz.question: connubial _____
quiz.explanation: 婚姻的, 婚姻幸福. The newlyweds enjoyed connubial bliss. 新婚夫妇享受婚姻幸福。 | con->共同，nub->结婚（拉丁nubere），connubial->共同结婚的=婚姻的（cf. nuptial婚礼的） || 文化联想：中文“百年好合”最适合帮助记忆 connubial，可以说 **connubial bliss — “The wedding wish ‘百年好合’ expresses the hope that a newly married couple will enjoy lasting connubial bliss.”**

quiz.question: glacial ____
quiz.explanation: 极慢的, 极慢的步伐. The project moved forward at a glacial pace. 该项目以极慢的步伐向前推进。 | glaci->冰（拉丁glacies），glacial->冰川般缓慢的（cf. glacier冰川） || 文化联想：中文“像蜗牛一样慢”最适合帮助记忆 glacial，可以说 **a glacial pace — “A permit that moves from office to office for months may proceed at a glacial pace—慢得像蜗牛爬.”**

quiz.question: judicial ______
quiz.explanation: 司法的, 司法审查. The court conducted a judicial review of the law. 法院对该法律进行了司法审查。 | judici->判断（拉丁judex->法官），judicial->法官/司法的（cf. judge法官，prejudice偏见） || 文化联想：包公故事所体现的依法断案、审查证据最适合帮助记忆 judicial，可以说 **judicial impartiality — “The popular image of Bao Zheng represents judicial impartiality: judging a case by law and evidence rather than status or personal ties.”**

quiz.question: cordial _________
quiz.explanation: 友好的, 友好关系. The two nations maintained cordial relations. 两国保持友好关系。 | cord->心脏（拉丁cor），cordial->发自心脏的=真诚友好的（cf. core核心，record记录=重新回心上） || 文化联想：“有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎”最适合帮助记忆 cordial，可以说 **a cordial welcome — “A host inspired by ‘有朋自远方来’ may give visiting friends a cordial welcome with tea, food, and warm conversation.”**

quiz.question: vestigial ____
quiz.explanation: 退化的, 退化的尾巴. Humans have a vestigial tail called the coccyx. 人类有一个称为尾骨的退化尾巴。 | vestig->脚印/痕迹（拉丁），vestigial->只留下痕迹的=退化的（cf. investigate调查=追踪脚印） || 文化联想：中国中学生物课讲人类尾骨时常把它作为退化遗迹来介绍，最适合帮助记忆 vestigial，可以说 **a vestigial structure — “The human tailbone is commonly taught as a vestigial structure inherited from ancestors with tails.”**

quiz.question: parochial ____
quiz.explanation: 狭隘的, 狭隘的观点. His parochial view prevented understanding other cultures. 他狭隘的观点阻碍了对其他文化的理解。 | par->旁边，oik->家（希腊），parochial->只顾自家教区的=狭隘的（cf. parish教区） || 文化联想：“井底之蛙”最适合帮助记忆 parochial，可以说 **a parochial view — “Someone who sees only the tiny world around him may develop a parochial view—like the frog at the bottom of a well.”**

quiz.question: filial ____
quiz.explanation: 孝顺的, 孝顺义务. Caring for elderly parents is a filial duty. 照顾年迈父母是孝顺义务。 | fili->儿女（拉丁filius），filial->儿女对父母的=孝顺的（cf. affiliate附属，affiliate=认作儿子） || 文化联想：“卧冰求鲤”等传统孝道故事最适合帮助记忆 filial，可以说 **filial duty — “Traditional stories such as ‘lying on ice for carp’ were told to dramatize extreme devotion to filial duty.”**

quiz.question: genial ____
quiz.explanation: 和蔼的, 和蔼的主人. The genial host made everyone feel welcome. 和蔼的主人让每个人都感到受欢迎。 | geni->天性/精神（拉丁genius），genial->天性和善的（cf. genius天才，congenial意气相投的） || 文化联想：中文“笑脸相迎”最适合帮助记忆 genial，可以说 **a genial host — “A genial host greets every guest with a warm smile, pours tea, and keeps the conversation easy.”**

quiz.question: congenial _______
quiz.explanation: 意气相投的, 意气相投的同伴. She enjoyed spending time with congenial company. 她喜欢与意气相投的同伴共度时光。 | con->共同，geni->天性，congenial->天性相同的=意气相投的（cf. genial和蔼的） || 文化联想：“酒逢知己千杯少”最适合帮助记忆 congenial，可以说 **congenial company — “When old friends discover that conversation flows effortlessly, they may enjoy congenial company—the feeling behind ‘酒逢知己千杯少.’”**
